text:
```yaml
name: Deployment Summary

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  deployment-summary:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v3
      with:
        node-version: '16'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Run tests
      run: npm test

    - name: Create deployment summary
      id: create_summary
      run: |
        echo "::set-output name=summary::Deployment successful! 🎉"
        echo "::set-output name=version::$(node -pe "require('./package.json').version")"

    - name: Send deployment summary to Slack
      uses: slackapi/slack-github-action@v2.1.1
      env:
        SLACK_BOT_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SLACK_BOT_TOKEN }}
      with:
        method: chat.postMessage
        channel: '#deployments'
        text: ${{ steps.create_summary.outputs.summary }}
        attachments: '[{"color": "#36a64f", "text": "Version: ${{ steps.create_summary.outputs.version }}"}]'
```
